Twilight Camp
Type: Master
Master.
Put this card in play with 4 counters. When you put a non-titled, non-
anarch vampire in play from your uncontrolled region, you may burn a
counter from this card to make that vampire anarch (and independent).
You may burn a counter from this card to add a blood to an anarch as a
master phase action. Burn this card when it has no counters.

Summon History
Type: Action
Requires: Temporis
Cost: X blood
[tem] Search your library and/or ash heap for an ally, retainer or

vampire and with starting life from the bank as needed).
[TEM] Search your crypt and/or ash heap for a non-scarce vampire with
capacity X or less. Put that vampire in play, with no blood.

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
On Feb 25, 10:36 am, Blooded Sand <sandm...@gmail.com> wrote:
> On Feb 25, 5:34 pm, Blooded Sand <sandm...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> > If a vampire is summon historied from my uncontrolled region, can i
> > put a counter on him from twilight camp?
> > obviously this would not work for a vampire summoned from my crypt....

> [TEM] Search your crypt and/or ash heap for a non-scarce vampire with

> capacity X or less. Put that vampire in play, with no blood.

Per the card text above, you cannot Summon History a vampire from your
uncontrolled region, only from your crypt or ash heap. Therefore, you
cannot Twilight Camp them.

-John Flournoy
